 UFC 334: Uros Medic vs. Kevin Holland Predictions & Odds
 Anatoly Pimentel 
 Nov 12, 2026, 7:17 PM 
 min read 
 (AP Photo/John Locher) 
 Ranked welterweight contenders Uros Medic and Kevin Holland are set to collide in the main card of UFC 334 on Saturday at Madison Square Garden in New York. 
 As the fighter with the higher ranking, Medic heads into the bout as the betting favorite with -165 UFC odds , while Holland, who’s fresh off a bounce-back win, will be the betting underdog with +135 odds. 
 UFC 334: Uros Medic vs. Kevin Holland Fight Odds 
 Uros Medic: -165 
 Kevin Holland: +135 
 UFC 334: Uros Medic vs. Kevin Holland: Tale of the Tape

 Age 33 34

 UFC 334: Uros Medic vs. Kevin Holland: Prediction 
 A decision win for Holland over Medic is my prediction because he’s the taller and longer fighter, and I expect him to fully maximize it in this fight. Holland has faced many heavy hitters in his career, and I don’t think Medic will knock him down or knock him out easily. 
 I think Holland will drag Medic into the deep waters of three rounds to see if his cardio holds up and if he has the grit. Medic has only gone to round three once in his UFC career, and all his other fights went to the second round or less. 
 Holland is also expected to use his grappling skills to take Medic down, grind him out with ground-and-pound strikes, and threaten several submissions to zap a chunk of energy out of him. 
 Uros Medic’s Recent Fight Results 
 Medic made his UFC debut in 2021 after securing a contract via Dana White’s Contender Series in 2020. He won four of his last five bouts, beating Gilbert Urbina, Muslim Salikhov, Geoff Neal, and Daniel Rodriguez. His only defeat during this period came at the hands of Punahele Soriano. 
 Kevin Holland’s Recent Fight Results 
 Holland is a UFC veteran who has been with the promotion since 2018. He recorded three wins and two losses in his last five outings inside the octagon, beating Gunnar Nelson, Vicente Luque, and Randy Brown, and losing to Daniel Rodriguez and Mike Malott.
